reviews.text:
Awful experience – I would never recommend this place.
I took my very poorly kitten in because I was worried about her and wanted her examined. Once we were there, I felt completely cornered and pressured. We were told that we effectively had only two options, and they would not allow us to simply take our kitten back home.
I ended up being charged just under £200, which I was told was the “cheaper” option. At an already heartbreaking and distressing time, the last thing anyone needs is to feel pressured into paying a large bill because they believe they have no other choice.
What upsets me most is that we would have preferred to take our kitten home, keep her comfortable and be with her during her final moments. Instead, I came away feeling that this choice had been taken out of our hands.
I understand that vets have a duty towards animal welfare, but owners should still be treated with compassion, dignity and clear communication — especially when they are distressed and dealing with a dying pet. I did not feel that we were.
I left feeling pressured, upset and disgusted by the whole experience. I would never recommend this practice, and I sincerely hope no other pet owner finds themselves in the position we were put in.

Excellent vets with caring staff. My old cat needed assistance and we were able to be seen the same day. Everything was explained to us about the treatment needed. Hopefully my cat will get better. Thanks to everyone at the practice, you're all super stars ⭐

Avoid this place at all costs. All they care about is money.
I brought my cat in to be neautered/micro chipped he was a lovely happy boy but ever since he’s been to this vets practice he’s became unwell, doesn’t let anyone touch him but me now. Eating and drinking fine. He’s had upset stomach now for over 6 days now. He’s basically on deaths door now 😞
I wish I looked at the reviews on here first as it’s full of bad reviews. If you love your pets do not bring them here
My was neutered two weeks ago by this vet and today she’s passed away at the age of 1 😞 what does this vet practise do to animals. This isn’t the first time I’ve heard of this vets doing the same.

If I could leave less than one star i would,  the way my very poorly cat was treated was absolutely disgusting,  the vet's thought more of selling cremations and paw prints than my cat that was there to be put to sleep.
Myself and the vets were arguing over the care that my cat was given,  and I told them to give me my money back, and I would of taken her somewhere more humanly.  They did not want to return my money so eventually due to my poorly cat I let them put her to sleep,  absolutely heartbroken 😢. £180, I was believed that that was also for her cremation. NO IT WASN'T.
I got a call 3 days later from a crematorium in Runcorn, saying they had my cat, and I  had to pay for her cremation.
Avoid this vet like the plague.  The rip people of, especially in the saddest of times.
We got our cat microchipped for only £22. Great customer service with a smile. Free advice given as well. Highly recommended

Big thank you to the team that supported us through a hard time. We were seen so quickly and efficiently. Everything was thoroughly explained and allowed us to have a choice during a hard time. This is a moment we won’t forget so I’m very grateful the ladies who supported us through it made it so seamless. Thank you again x
Very pleased with the service and professionalism of all the staff i had contact with, right from the initial phone call for advise to the 2 vets that i saw Thank You

Thank you for taking the time to leave a review. We are sorry to see that your experience may not have met your expectations. As no additional details were provided, we are unable to understand what went wrong or how we could have helped further.

We are committed to providing the highest standard of care and service to all of our clients, and we would welcome the opportunity to discuss your experience. Please feel free to contact us directly so that we can better understand your concerns and learn from your feedback.
Thank you for your 5-star review. We are grateful for your support and delighted that you had a positive experience with our team. Your feedback is greatly appreciated.

Honestly, take the bad reviews in! This place is shocking, money mad, not for the pets at all.
£180 to put the cat down, get a call 2 days after from Liverpool to say the cat is here we want money for the cat to be cremated and scattered.

Firstly this was not agreed to, secondly you show no remorse at all when a family is having the pet put down it’s just pay first, why not after? Joke! No wonder why the customers are reporting you and leaving.
This is definitely an animal caring loving vets....I have had diffrent members of the practice and all have been extremely excellent and helpful....definitely would recommend bringing your pets here.
My cat Lily enjoyed her annual check up so much she didn't want to leave and sat on the scales 😹😹 …

Unfortunately, my dog had a very distressing experience with this practice during my his admission for a dental procedure.

My dog has a clearly documented history of severe anxiety which has been noted at every visit, he has been like this since he was a pup. Despite this, his records were not reviewed prior to admission and he was admitted as a routine patient.

He was left in a kennel for approximately 3.5 hours. During that time he became extremely distressed and ultimately urinated and defecated on himself. I received a phone call asking if I could return to the practice to assist with sedating him, and when I collected him he was shaking, petrified and covered in urine and faeces.

I was also very concerned to see him being handled on a slip lead despite him being a dachshund, a breed predisposed to spinal issues such as IVDD.

The practice has since acknowledged that his records should have been reviewed beforehand and that there were shortcomings in how his admission was handled. They have said they have reviewed their protocols following this.

I hope that the changes they have discussed help prevent another anxious animal going through a similar experience.

Nice clean practice
Friendly staff.
All the staff here are excellent! Tatiyanna was exceptional during my visit today. This vet practice shows excellent care!
Very friendly staff
Best service ever and always great staff

We're so grateful to Your Vets, particularly Barbara, at Sheldon, for their excellent care. Our cat had only been with us 6 weeks so we weren't sure what 'normal' was. When she became lethargic and lost her appetite I took her to the vets, and Barbara quickly ran tests, did a scan and drained fluid from her lungs. She made a clinical diagnosis and was able to source treatment quickly (especially given it was New Year's Eve!) The fast action made a huge difference, and our girl is now on the mend. All the vets, nurses and other staff are so compassionate and really care. Thank you all 🥰

Went to see this surgery as an emergency for a semi feral cat that has been living out of our brick shed for about 5 years. We inherited him from an elderly neighbour who passed away. He seemed like a well built healthy cat. He started developing scabs on his ears which we first assumed were from fighting. Turned out to be cancer. Was absolutely horrified. Was told he was in his teens/ senior cat and would need further investigation. Felt soo guilty for thinking it was just battle scars.
Messed up my phone accessibility settings and couldn’t work out how to undo them so that I could pay the bill. I lovely gentleman by the name of Daniel at reception, saved the day by fixing the issue. Unfortunately he also had to listen to my nervous ramblings( I tend to do this when in shock and stressed!) He was extremely good natured about it. Lovely knowledgeable nurse explained next steps clearly and patiently with our adopted cat. Still gutted, but they made the whole procedure so much more bearable. Clearly a good animal loving calm practice ( and very tolerant of customers too😂) further away from my usual clinic in Solihull but will definitely be visiting here in future. Highly recommend to anyone who wants their little babies/ pets looked after well. 5 star service

There have been a few hiccups with Fudge and our time with the vets, but they have been more than happy to resolve and/or explain things clearly!

The vets and nurses are always very lovely with Fudge, even if he is wary/anxious/etc

Thank you guys for doing so well with my boyo!
Very helpful always polite prices reasonable
Lovely staff, always go above and beyond to help you.
Staff are kind,friendly and happy how they treat my dog .My Dog Griselda is up to date with her vaccination,check up and flee ointment and tablet.I am a very satisfied with the service .

The team at YourVets Sheldon are absolutely fantastic. Every member of staff is professional, caring, and genuinely dedicated to providing the best care possible. They always take the time to explain everything clearly and make sure both pets and owners feel comfortable and confident.

I hadn't been here before, but my rat River got really ill so I rushed her to here. Sadly she had a tumour so had to be put to sleep, but all the staff here couldn't of been better. The woman at reception rushed to me as soon as I walked in and took River straight to the back to the vet. I was in a bit of a panic and the staff were very kind and patient with me. They even let me wait in a private room. Like I said River had to be put to sleep and the vet was extremely kind when she had to break the news to me.  And if the staff wasnt already going above what they had to do, they even sent me a hand written card with there sympathy.  I hope I don't ever have a need to visit again, but if I do i feel more than confident that the staff here will do everything they can to help

Please avoid this vets at all costs.

We feel completely let down and heartbroken by our experience with this vet. Our puppy was spayed on Friday and began showing signs of being unwell by Sunday. We rushed her back, expecting them to take her in for monitoring and proper care. Instead, we were offered multiple tests, all of which we paid for, but the results took 48 hours to come back, by which point we had lost our puppy. We were also given several different medications, again at our own cost, and then sent home without any clear explanation or cause for her symptoms. We were reassured that it was nothing to be overly concerned about — yet only hours later, our puppy tragically passed away. The vets have since admitted that they let her go home without knowing what was wrong, we are completely disgusted that they let her go home in this situation.

We trusted them to care for our baby, and that trust was completely misplaced. We are devastated and feel utterly failed by their lack of urgency and knowledge and are now left without answers. Please think very carefully before taking your pet here.

Avoid at all costs,,  so we took our dog to them as it’s hurt it’s leg, they first told us to rest it and another check up in two weeks, when we went back another vet seen us and kept saying the dog needs a xray at a cost of £800 and if there’s a fracture you will be looking at another £6000,  we didn’t have the money at the time so needed to go away and sort something out, a week later they phoned us so we could take the dog to have a check up once again a different vet was examining the leg saying o she’s lost a bit of muscle in that leg to which then we pointed out to him his examining the wrong leg,, he also told us if we don’t get it xrayed by that afternoon they will report us to the rspca,  as soon as we left there we got the dog booked into another vets for today, but in the mean time yourvets in Sheldon reported us to rspca who came out seen my dog and said herself that her leg isn’t as bad as she thought it was and couldn’t understand why they reported us,   Took her to different vets today who happy that she hasn’t broken or fractured it,  JUST PROVED THERE ONLY AFTER YOUR MONEY

Horrible place no companion at all  over priced care and wanted to put my cat to sleep rather than help me treat him. They threatened to cal lthe rspca as I couldn't afford their ridulas prices took him else where and got treated and os doing great for a quarter.of the price. Shocking
Expensive

I believe the vets is extremely over priced for a service that doesn’t feel like you actually have my animals vets interest at heart.
I’ve been before and immediate reaction was to remove my dogs eye but actually eye drops sorted the eye just the same!
Previously I have been and without really checking my animal, you deemed she didn’t have an infection without checking temp or really examining her. Second opinion showed that she had a rotting tooth!
Won’t be using this vets again! All they care about is money!

On the downside, it seems to be an extremely busy practice and it's very difficult to get an appointment. We had to wait over 3 months to neuter our dog

Please don't use these so called vets, they are only after your money, after seeing 3 different vets and not any of them knowing what they were doing, after we had been home for an hour they sent us a text message saying our dog had cancer in his eye disgusting

Avoid at all cost we brought our cat here to be neutered and a week later he was dead, we brought him home he was clearly very unwell from the first day bringing him back they offered to do tests at a price of £2500 which we couldn't afford, and now he's dead. Do not bring your pets here!! All this place is interested in is taking your money! Look at the other reviews!! Absolutely heart broken and fuming!!
Can't thank the vet and staff here enough they where outstanding with the care for my boy chase truly from the bottom of my heart u r all amazing
